content_sections.heading: MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 (two) posts have been announced for the post of Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics under the Excise & Narcotics Department, Government of Mizoram. The number of posts is provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement. Reservation benefits (if any) will be as per Government of Mizoram norms for SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the relevant cut-off dates. Only candidates who meet educational, physical, computer proficiency, Mizo language proficiency and age criteria are eligible. Documentary support to prove fulfilment of eligibility conditions should not be dated later than the last date for submission of application.

rows.details: Bachelor’s degree from a recognised University.

Male: Height at least 160 cm (5 ft 3 inches); Chest Normal 84 cm (33 inches), Expanded 89 cm (35 inches). Female: Height at least 155 cm (5 ft 1 inch); Chest Normal 75 cm (29.5 inches), Expanded 76 cm (30 inches). BMI: Normal BMI value (± 20%) for both.
As prescribed by the Mizoram Group ‘A’, ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts Service/Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2023. (Details: https://tinyurl.com/comp-proficiency)

Must achieve pass mark in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency. Exempted if studied Mizo subject in Class-X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram or opted for Mizo as MIL outside Mizoram. (Details: https://tinyurl.com/mizo-language-proficiency)
Must satisfy all conditions of eligibility as per notification. Government servants to apply through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Who should NOT apply for MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not possess a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised University. Candidates outside the age band 18–30 years as on 01-08-2026 (except notified relaxations for SC/ST). Candidates who fail to meet the prescribed Physical Measurement standards (Height, Chest, BMI). Candidates unable to qualify the minimum standards in each event of the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Candidates without the required Computer Proficiency as per Mizoram Group ‘A’, ‘B’ & ‘C’ posts Rules, 2023. Candidates who do not possess Mizo Language Proficiency (and are not exempted). Candidates who fail to upload all mandatory documents by the closing date. Candidates who attempt canvassing directly or indirectly. Government servants who do not apply through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shall apply online; no other mode of application will be accepted. Probable applicants who have not registered in the one-time-registration portal must register and submit their application well in advance before the last date of submission. An applicant must verify that his/her application is actually submitted after payment is made, otherwise the claim of the applicant regarding his/her candidature will not be entertained. Mandatory Documents to be uploaded (before last date): Marksheets of HSLC & above Educational Certificates of HSLC & above Proof of Computer Proficiency Proof of proficiency in Mizo Language SC/ST Certificate (for SC/ST candidates only) Proof of date of birth Graduation certificate and complete marksheets Any other relevant documents in the “Others” field For queries: MPSC Helpline No. 0389-3596493 on working days between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Applicants can also approach the MPSC on all working days during office hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 28 August 2026 upto 4:00 PM through https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPSC ASI Excise & Narcotics 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 (two) posts of Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics under the Excise & Narcotics Department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for MPSC Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MPSC ASI Excise Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 to 30 years as on 1st August 2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years upper age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. Is Physical Efficiency Test (PET) mandatory for MPSC ASI Excise & Narcotics?
faq.answer: Yes. PET (High Jump, Long Jump, 100m Sprint, 1 km Race) carrying 150 marks (qualifying 60) is mandatory. PET marks will be added to the final score.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics in Mizoram?
faq.answer: The post carries Level – 6 in the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q7. Is Mizo language proficiency required for MPSC ASI Excise post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must pass the Mizo Language Proficiency test unless exempted (studied Mizo in HSLC or above within Mizoram or as MIL outside Mizoram).
